title: MV Trying to Sell Item/Equip that is one of a kind Warning

posts.author: Twig_the_Blue_Pikmin
posts.body: Basically, I have some items/equips you can only get once in my entire game that you eventually find better versions of later down the line so I want them to still be able to be sold once they no longer are useful. But the thing is I dont want them to be sold without a warning beforehand that you wont be able to get that specific item/equip back ever again (similar to how other rpg games do it, like Dragon Quest for example) and I havent seen a single sell plugin that implements this feature so I thought I'd see if anyone knew of one or wanted to make one? Specifically for RPG Maker MV as that is the version im using

posts.author: ShadowDragon
posts.body:
its a confirmation window.
I do have for my item scene, so it might be relative easy to implement
into the Scene_ShopSell or Window_ShopSell to let it pop up.
but I think it needs to be altered a bit more for the "cannot sell" or
want it to pop up and ignore the rest of the items that doesn't need it,
else it can be pretty annoying.
